notes: Conversational skill: a live human can't be interviewed by a test subagent, so each prompt bakes the interview answers in. Runs execute in a git worktree (pristine fresh-checkout: tracked .example templates present, the user's real gitignored personal files absent) with an empty DB seeded from tests/fixtures/schema.sql, so no run can touch the operator's real profile/config/resume/db. Résumé fixtures live in evals/fixtures/ (design_resume.docx is regenerable via make_design_docx.py).

evals.name: full-onboard-finance
evals.prompt: Onboard me — set up this whole thing for my job search. I'm a mid-level finance person, about 4 years in, currently in equity research and trying to move to the buy-side. My #1 target is private equity, then investment banking, and I'd still take equity research roles. I definitely do NOT want sales & trading or back-office / operations roles. Hard requirements: I need visa sponsorship, I can only work in New York City or fully remote, I have a Master's degree, no security clearance, and no internships. I'm genuinely into fintech and payments. My résumé is the text file at .claude/skills/onboard-me/evals/fixtures/finance_resume.txt . Also please get Databricks (boards.greenhouse.io/databricks) onto my watchlist. Take me all the way to the point of the first run, but don't actually launch the pipeline — I'll kick it off myself.
evals.expected_output: A full guided setup: writes apps/worker/resume/personal_profile.txt with all six sections (STAGE, TARGET priority order, ANTI-TARGETS, POSITIONING, INTERESTS, CAVEATS), PE ranked above IB and sales&trading/ops as anti-targets; writes apps/worker/resume/resume.txt from the fixture's real text; fills config.yaml candidate block (needs visa sponsorship, Master's, NYC+remote, exclude_internships true); sets finance categories in the DB with an Others catch-all; delegates the Databricks add to the onboard-board flow (greenhouse platform, no new adapter); ends by presenting `python -m ats_worker.run --once`. Never edits score.txt.

assertions.name: profile_file_written
assertions.text: apps/worker/resume/personal_profile.txt was created.

assertions.name: profile_has_all_sections
assertions.text: The profile contains all six section headers: STAGE, TARGET, ANTI-TARGETS, POSITIONING, INTERESTS, CAVEATS.

assertions.name: profile_target_order_correct
assertions.text: In the TARGET section, private equity is priority 1 and appears before investment banking.

assertions.name: profile_anti_targets_correct
assertions.text: ANTI-TARGETS lists sales & trading and/or back-office/operations.

assertions.name: resume_text_ingested
assertions.text: apps/worker/resume/resume.txt exists and contains real résumé content from the fixture (e.g. 'Equity Research' and 'Columbia'), not a placeholder.

assertions.name: candidate_constraints_set
assertions.text: config.yaml candidate block sets work_authorization to 'needs visa sponsorship', highest_degree 'Master\'s', exclude_internships true, and locations covering NYC + remote.

assertions.name: categories_persisted
assertions.text: The app_settings 'categories' DB row is set to finance labels and includes an Others catch-all.

assertions.name: watchlist_delegated
assertions.text: Databricks is added via the onboard-board platform path (greenhouse/databricks) — no new adapter file and no hand-rolled scraper.

assertions.name: first_run_surfaced
assertions.text: The run ends by presenting `python -m ats_worker.run --once` as the activation step.

assertions.name: score_txt_untouched
assertions.text: apps/worker/ats_worker/prompts/score.txt was not modified.

evals.name: categories-only-product
evals.prompt: I'm a product manager — can you set up my job categories? I mostly apply for Product Management, Growth, and Product Marketing roles.
evals.expected_output: Does the ONE thing asked: sets the DB categories to Product Management / Growth / Product Marketing plus an Others catch-all, and stops. Does not build a profile, edit config.yaml, ingest a résumé, or run the pipeline — the user only asked for categories.

assertions.name: categories_persisted
assertions.text: The app_settings 'categories' DB row is set to Product Management, Growth, Product Marketing, plus an Others catch-all.

assertions.name: scope_respected_no_profile
assertions.text: personal_profile.txt was NOT created (the user only asked for categories).

assertions.name: scope_respected_no_config
assertions.text: The config.yaml candidate block was NOT written/edited.

assertions.name: score_txt_untouched
assertions.text: apps/worker/ats_worker/prompts/score.txt was not modified.

evals.name: profile-and-docx-resume-design
evals.prompt: Help me build my fit profile and pull in my résumé. I'm a senior product designer, 7 years in. I want to move toward staff/lead IC design and design-systems ownership — I'm not interested in pure visual/marketing design or agency / client-services work. I care a lot about design tools and developer-facing products. My résumé is the Word doc at .claude/skills/onboard-me/evals/fixtures/design_resume.docx . Just the profile and résumé for now.
evals.expected_output: Writes apps/worker/resume/personal_profile.txt (all six sections; STAGE reflects senior/~7yr; TARGET is design-systems / staff-lead IC design; ANTI-TARGETS covers agency/client-services and marketing/visual design) and extracts the .docx into apps/worker/resume/resume.txt as clean text. Does the profile + résumé only — no categories, watchlist, or .env, since that's all the user asked for. Never edits score.txt.

assertions.name: profile_file_written
assertions.text: apps/worker/resume/personal_profile.txt was created.

assertions.name: profile_has_all_sections
assertions.text: The profile contains all six section headers: STAGE, TARGET, ANTI-TARGETS, POSITIONING, INTERESTS, CAVEATS.

assertions.name: profile_stage_senior
assertions.text: The STAGE section reflects a senior designer with roughly 7 years of experience.

assertions.name: profile_targets_correct
assertions.text: TARGET mentions design systems and/or staff-lead IC design; ANTI-TARGETS covers agency/client-services and/or marketing/visual design.

assertions.name: resume_docx_extracted
assertions.text: apps/worker/resume/resume.txt exists and contains real content from the .docx (e.g. 'Northwind' and 'design system'), proving the docx was extracted — not XML tags and not a punt.

assertions.name: scope_respected_partial
assertions.text: The run does profile + résumé only; it does NOT set categories, add watchlist boards, or write .env.

assertions.name: score_txt_untouched
assertions.text: apps/worker/ats_worker/prompts/score.txt was not modified.

evals.name: vague-opening-no-info
evals.note: Discriminating case for the conversational path: the user's whole message is 'onboard me' with zero context. Correct behavior is to ASK (walk them through it) — NOT to invent a persona, targets, résumé, or companies and write personal files from made-up data. Unlike evals 0-2, this run is allowed to ask questions and stop.
evals.expected_output: Follows the skill's adaptive Step 1: recognizes there is nothing to work with and asks the user for their targets/stage/dealbreakers/résumé/companies (conversationally), then stops awaiting answers. Does NOT fabricate a profile, does NOT set categories or a watchlist from invented data, does NOT run the pipeline, and never touches score.txt.

assertions.name: asks_not_fabricates
assertions.text: The run asks the user for their information (targets, stage, dealbreakers, résumé, companies) rather than inventing a persona and proceeding.

assertions.name: no_fabricated_profile
assertions.text: No personal_profile.txt with invented career specifics was written (ideally the file isn't written at all, because there's nothing real to write).

assertions.name: no_invented_db_writes
assertions.text: No categories row and no watchlist rows were written from made-up data (categories empty, watched_companies empty).

assertions.name: score_txt_untouched
assertions.text: apps/worker/ats_worker/prompts/score.txt was not modified.
